title: Rabbah bar Yosef
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: Rabbah bar Yosef reported in Rav’s name, as recorded in [Arakhin 5b](https://www.sefaria.org/Arakhin.5b.3).[^1]

notes.text: Hyman gives only the attribution. The linked passage names Rabbah bar Yosef transmitting Rav’s ruling about someone who consecrates another person’s animal. It also gives Rav Yeiva bar Yosei as an alternative transmitter.
